summary: Frontend regression for Depth Route Dialer iteration 2 — UI stability fixes + SIP switcher context + simulated /call screen. All 9 requested frontend flows PASSED. Login via demo@depthroute.com/demo1234 works. Dashboard renders with no wrapped text — Account Balance shows '$125.45' on one line, Current Plan shows 'Professional Plan' cleanly, 'Calling as Telnyx US Trunk +1 202-555-0143' chip visible. SIP picker sheet opens from Dashboard, Dialer, and Billing; all 5 SIP accounts (Telnyx / Twilio / Bandwidth / Vonage / Plivo) render. Selecting one propagates to all screens and persists via storage. Dialer keypad → call button navigates to /call which shows correct number, state transitions Dialing→Ringing→mm:ss timer within ~4s, and 'Calling via <selected SIP>' matches the current selection. Mute/Keypad/DTMF/Hold/Hangup all functional; Hold flips state to 'On Hold'; Hangup returns to Dialer. Billing money values all render with 2 decimals via toLocaleString (e.g. $52,345.20, $2,950.20). Recent-call-btn-0 and contact-call-1 both navigate to /call with correct params. Backend not retested (per request — no server changes).
critical_code_review_comments: SipPickerSheet close on backdrop press and via testID='sip-picker-close' both wired correctly.
SipContext persists selection via storage.setItem under key 'selected_sip_id' — verified end-to-end persistence Billing→Dashboard.
call.tsx uses expo-haptics correctly (no expo-av / deprecated packages).
billing.tsx money() helper uses en-US locale with 2 fraction digits — validated no bad decimals in rendered output.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing demo user demo@depthroute.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SipProvider is registered inside AuthProvider in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx. Bottom-sheet options may render below the mobile viewport; use scroll_into_view_if_needed() before clicking sip-picker-item-* items. Login form testID for submit button is missing — use text='Sign In' to click. Call screen transitions: Dialing (0.9s) → Ringing (2.8s) → connected (timer). Money format helper in billing.tsx: toLocaleString('en-US',{min:2,max:2}).
rca_of_issue: N/A — original bug ('UI not stable + user can change SIP trunk from Billing + Make app to call using SIP account + user can select SIP account from which it can call') is resolved. Verified: (1) Dashboard header no longer wraps balance/plan text (two side-by-side cards); (2) SipContext + SipPickerSheet allow SIP selection from Dashboard/Dialer/Billing with propagation and storage persistence; (3) Dialer green call button navigates to /call which explicitly displays 'Calling via <selected SIP>' proving the SIP is used to place the call in the simulated flow.
